translations.web: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.
translations.bsb: Do not be quickly provoked in your spirit, for anger settles in the lap of a fool.
translations.kjv: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
